input.quote: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party.
input.rationale: Section 20(d) is a blanket bar on assignment by either party absent the other's written consent, with no affiliate or M&A successor carve-out for Sparkling and no reasonableness standard on consent; Section 3(c) reinforces this one-sidedly against Sparkling (and the licence itself is "non-transferable" under Section 2). That fails even the fallback (successor assignment on written notice, consent not unreasonably withheld) and sits in walk-away territory for a customer M&A event. Termination triggers in Section 17 contain no change-of-control right for Garman, which is acceptable; the redline preserves that by stating expressly that our change of control gives Garman no termination or re-pricing right, and adds the affiliate/successor carve-out plus a reasonableness standard and no-competitor limit on Garman assignments.

proposal.summary: Add affiliate/successor assignment carve-out for Sparkling and a reasonableness standard on Garman assignments
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added customary affiliate and transaction successor rights so an internal reorganisation or M&A deal does not require Garman's consent, and made consent for other assignments subject to a reasonableness standard with no assignment to our competitors. We also conformed Section 3(c) to this carve-out.

ops.oldText: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party.
ops.newText: (d) Sparkling may assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the consent of Garman to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or of the business to which this Agreement relates, upon written notice to Garman. Garman may not assign this Agreement or any rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of Sparkling, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, and in no event to a competitor of Sparkling. Except as set out above, neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party, which shall not be unreasonably withheld. No change of control of Sparkling shall give Garman any right to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement.

ops.newText: (c) except as permitted by Section 20(d), not assign this Agreement or transfer
